dominant_mood: a fluorescent release board that opens into a night map
background_logic: deep indigo holds a sequence of paper, orange, lime and blue signal fields
palette_logic: indigo for the clock, paper for verification, orange for movement, lime for confirmed windows, blue for open questions
type_scale_logic: compressed display titles for entry points, readable 18px body copy, monospaced timestamps and source labels
image_behavior: one original local SVG information figure per story; no third-party editorial photography
page_density_and_tempo: dense cover, two release-led majors, tactile signals, explicit runway gap, forward-looking watches, quiet exit
core_visual_action: a route changes from clock to object to room to city without pretending the signals are one trend
cover_composition: a large moving-entry title beside a route board connecting drop, release, object, gallery and runway
desktop_interaction_mechanic: a sticky issue index remains visible on desktop; the mobile details panel opens a no-JS index without hiding the article
behance_viewing_arc: entry window, release system, object translation, public room, curatorial power, runway gap, future watch
mobile_translation: single-column figures, two-column index disclosure, shorter display headings, captions retained below every figure
mobbin_usability_constraint: 44px links, scroll-margin for anchored headings, readable source labels, no nested scrolling in the redesigned historical reader
quiet_ending: an intentionally unfilled runway radar and one sentence waiting for the next verified drop
